interface.shortDescription: Build and deploy apps & bots from chat
interface.longDescription: Operate your DreamAgent account conversationally: create websites, Telegram bots, Discord bots and schedulers; watch them build and go live; then edit them with natural-language instructions ('add a /weather command', 'fix the login bug', 'restyle the dashboard'). DreamAgent's AI agent handles the code, tests, rebuild and redeploy automatically. Uses your plan's AI credits.
capabilities: Edit existing projects via natural-language instructions
